##### Project general facts

The Bristol is an ultra-luxury residential development by Emaar Properties in collaboration with The Bristol brand. The project presents a striking architectural composition with a basement level, ground floor, multiple podium levels, hotel apartments, residential floors, and a rooftop, all designed with a sense of movement, rhythm, and elegance that reflects its high-end identity.

Residents can choose from premium 1 to 4-bedroom apartments as well as exclusive 5-bedroom penthouses, each designed with refined layouts and sophisticated interiors. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame panoramic views of Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and Burj Al Arab, creating a constant connection to the surrounding seascape and skyline while enhancing the sense of space and light throughout the homes.

The development offers world-class amenities, including a fully equipped gym, an expansive swimming pool, and elegant communal spaces designed for comfort and relaxation. Its prime location provides direct access to Dubai Harbour and Marina & Yacht Club, with Dubai Marina just minutes away, and seamless connectivity via Sheikh Zayed Road, making it an ideal address for a refined waterfront lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Emaar Beachfront is an exclusive and luxurious beachfront community located in Dubai. This exquisite destination offers a harmonious blend of upscale living, stunning views, and a beachside lifestyle.

Emaar Beachfront is strategically situated between Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, offering residents easy access to some of the city's most iconic landmarks and entertainment hubs. The community spans across a pristine shoreline, providing residents with direct access to the sparkling waters of the Arabian Gulf and the warm sandy beaches.

Emaar Beachfront also boasts an array of world-class amenities and facilities. Residents can indulge in a resort-style living experience with access to swimming pools, fitness centers, gourmet dining options, and lush landscaped gardens. The community is designed to offer a holistic lifestyle, combining relaxation, recreation, and convenience within a picturesque setting.
